controls.name: mandate and commitment
controls.description: Management should define and endorse the risk management policy; ensure that the organization's culture and risk management policy are aligned; determine risk management performance indicators that align with performance indicators of the organization; align risk management objectives with the objectives and strategies of the organization; ensure legal and regulatory compliance; assign accountabilities and responsibilities at appropriate levels within the organization; ensure that the necessary resources are allocated to risk management; communicate the benefits of risk management to all stakeholders; and ensure that the framework for managing risk continues to remain appropriate.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive risk management policy that outlines the organization's commitment to risk management and aligns with its overall objectives.
Assign specific roles and responsibilities for risk management to individuals at various levels within the organization to ensure accountability.
Establish performance indicators for risk management that are consistent with the organization's broader performance metrics to facilitate alignment.
Allocate necessary resources, including budget and personnel, to support the implementation and maintenance of the risk management framework.
Communicate the importance and benefits of risk management to all stakeholders through training sessions and informational materials.

controls.name: design of framework for managing risk
controls.description: The organization should ensure that there is accountability, authority and appropriate competence for managing risk, including implementing and maintaining the risk management process and ensuring the adequacy, effectiveness and efficiency of any controls.

deployment_points.name: Define clear roles and responsibilities for risk management within the organization to establish accountability and authority.
Ensure that personnel involved in risk management possess the necessary skills and training to effectively implement and maintain the risk management process.
Develop a structured risk management process that includes identification, assessment, response, and monitoring of risks.
Regularly review and update the risk management framework to ensure its adequacy and effectiveness in addressing emerging risks.
Implement a system for reporting and escalating risk management issues to ensure timely decision-making and action.

controls.name: implementing risk management
controls.description: In implementing the organization's framework for managing risk, the organization should define the appropriate timing and strategy for implementing the framework; apply the risk management policy and process to the organizational processes; comply with legal and regulatory requirements; ensure that decision making, including the development and setting of objectives, is aligned with the outcomes of risk management processes; hold information and training sessions; and communicate and consult with stakeholders to ensure that its risk management framework remains appropriate.

deployment_points.name: Create a detailed implementation plan that outlines the timing and strategy for rolling out the risk management framework across the organization.
Integrate the risk management policy into existing organizational processes to ensure it is applied consistently.
Conduct regular training sessions for employees to ensure they understand the risk management processes and their roles within it.
Establish a communication plan to keep stakeholders informed about the risk management framework and any updates or changes.
Monitor compliance with legal and regulatory requirements throughout the implementation process to mitigate potential risks.

controls.name: monitoring and review of the framework
controls.description: In order to ensure that risk management is effective and continues to support organizational performance, the organization should measure risk management performance against indicators, which are periodically reviewed for appropriateness; periodically measure progress against, and deviation from, the risk management plan; periodically review whether the risk management framework, policy and plan are still appropriate, given the organizations' external and internal context; report on risk, progress with the risk management plan and how well the risk management policy is being followed; and review the effectiveness of the risk management framework.

deployment_points.name: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for risk management that will be used to measure its effectiveness and efficiency.
Conduct regular reviews of the risk management framework to assess its relevance and effectiveness in light of changing internal and external conditions.
Implement a reporting system to track progress against the risk management plan and identify any deviations.
Schedule periodic audits of the risk management processes to ensure compliance with the established framework and policies.
Communicate findings from reviews and audits to stakeholders to promote transparency and continuous improvement.

controls.name: continual improvement of the framework
controls.description: Based on results of monitoring and reviews, decisions should be made on how the risk management framework, policy and plan can be improved. These decisions should lead to improvements in the organization's management of risk and its risk management culture.

deployment_points.name: Analyze data from monitoring and review activities to identify areas for improvement in the risk management framework.
Develop an action plan that outlines specific improvements to be made based on the analysis of monitoring results.
Engage stakeholders in discussions about potential improvements to ensure buy-in and support for changes.
Implement changes to the risk management framework and policies in a timely manner to enhance effectiveness.
Establish a feedback loop to continuously gather input on the risk management framework and make adjustments as necessary.

controls.name: communication and consultation
controls.description: Communication and consultation with external and internal stakeholders should take place during all stages of the risk management process. Therefore, plans for communication and consultation should be developed at an early stage. These should address issues relating to the risk itself, its causes, its consequences (if known), and the measures being taken to treat it.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive communication plan that outlines how and when stakeholders will be engaged throughout the risk management process.
Identify key stakeholders and their information needs to ensure relevant communication is provided at each stage.
Schedule regular consultation sessions with stakeholders to discuss risks, their causes, and potential impacts.
Create informational materials that clearly explain the risk management process and the measures being taken to address identified risks.
Ensure that feedback from stakeholders is collected and incorporated into the risk management process to enhance collaboration.

controls.name: understanding of the organization and its context
controls.description: Before starting the design and implementation of the framework for managing risk, it is important to evaluate and understand both the external and internal context of the organization, since these can significantly influence the design of the framework.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough analysis of the internal and external environments to identify factors that may impact risk management.
Gather data on organizational culture, structure, and processes to inform the design of the risk management framework.
Engage with stakeholders to understand their perspectives on risks and the organizational context.
Document findings from the analysis to create a baseline understanding of the organization's context.
Use the insights gained to tailor the risk management framework to better fit the organization's specific needs and challenges.

controls.name: establishing risk management policy
controls.description: The risk management policy should clearly state the organization's objectives for, and commitment to, risk management and typically addresses the following: the organization's rationale for managing risk; links between the organization's objectives and policies and the risk management policy; accountabilities and responsibilities for managing risk; the way in which conflicting interests are dealt with; commitment to make the necessary resources available to assist those accountable and responsible for managing risk; the way in which risk management performance will be measured and reported; and commitment to review and improve the risk management policy and framework periodically and in response to an event or change in circumstances.

deployment_points.name: Draft a risk management policy that articulates the organization's objectives and commitment to effective risk management.
Clearly define roles and responsibilities within the policy to ensure accountability for managing risks.
Establish mechanisms for measuring and reporting on risk management performance to track progress and effectiveness.
Include provisions in the policy for addressing conflicting interests to maintain integrity in risk management.
Schedule regular reviews of the risk management policy to ensure it remains relevant and effective in light of changing circumstances.

controls.name: accountability
controls.description: The organization should ensure that there is accountability, authority and appropriate competence for managing risk, including implementing and maintaining the risk management process and ensuring the adequacy, effectiveness and efficiency of any controls.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the accountability structure for risk management within the organization to clarify roles and responsibilities.
Ensure that individuals responsible for risk management have the necessary authority to make decisions and take actions.
Provide training and resources to enhance the competence of personnel involved in risk management.
Regularly assess the effectiveness of the accountability framework to ensure it meets organizational needs.
Establish a reporting mechanism for accountability to ensure transparency and oversight in risk management activities.

controls.name: integration into organizational processes
controls.description: Risk management should be embedded in all the organization's practices and processes in a way that it is relevant, effective and efficient. The risk management process should become part of, and not separate from, those organizational processes.

deployment_points.name: Identify key organizational processes where risk management can be integrated to enhance relevance and effectiveness.
Develop guidelines for embedding risk management practices into daily operations and decision-making processes.
Train employees on the importance of integrating risk management into their roles and responsibilities.
Monitor the integration of risk management into organizational processes to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
Continuously review and refine integration practices to adapt to changing organizational needs and external conditions.

controls.name: defining risk criteria
controls.description: The organization should define criteria to be used to evaluate the significance of risk. The criteria should reflect the organization's values, objectives and resources. Some criteria can be imposed by, or derived from, legal and regulatory requirements and other requirements to which the organization subscribes. Risk criteria should be consistent with the organization's risk management policy, be defined at the beginning of any risk management process and be continually reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Identify key organizational values and objectives that will inform the risk criteria.
Develop a draft set of risk criteria that includes legal, regulatory, and internal requirements.
Review the draft criteria with relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment and comprehensiveness.
Finalize the risk criteria and document them in the organization's risk management policy.
Establish a schedule for regular review and updates of the risk criteria to ensure they remain relevant.

controls.name: establishing internal communication and reporting mechanisms
controls.description: The organization should establish internal communication and reporting mechanisms in order to support and encourage accountability and ownership of risk. These mechanisms should ensure that: key components of the risk management framework, and any subsequent modifications, are communicated appropriately; there is adequate internal reporting on the framework, its effectiveness and the outcomes; relevant information derived from the application of risk management is available at appropriate levels and times; and there are processes for consultation with internal stakeholders.

deployment_points.name: Define the key components of the risk management framework that need to be communicated internally.
Develop a communication plan that outlines how and when information will be shared with stakeholders.
Implement reporting mechanisms that allow for regular updates on risk management activities and outcomes.
Create feedback loops to gather input from stakeholders on the effectiveness of the communication and reporting processes.
Train staff on their roles and responsibilities regarding risk communication and reporting.

controls.name: establishing external communication and reporting mechanisms
controls.description: The organization should develop and implement a plan as to how it will communicate with external stakeholders. This should involve: engaging appropriate external stakeholders and ensuring an effective exchange of information; external reporting to comply with legal, regulatory, and governance requirements; providing feedback and reporting on communication and consultation; using communication to build confidence in the organization; and communicating with stakeholders in the event of a crisis or contingency.

deployment_points.name: Identify key external stakeholders and their information needs regarding risk management.
Develop a comprehensive external communication plan that includes methods and frequency of communication.
Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements in all external reporting activities.
Establish a process for gathering and incorporating feedback from external stakeholders into communication strategies.
Prepare crisis communication protocols to ensure timely and effective communication during emergencies.

controls.name: general
controls.description: Risk assessment is the overall process of risk identification, risk analysis and risk evaluation. NOTE ISO/IEC 31010 provides guidance on risk assessment techniques.

deployment_points.name: Familiarize the team with ISO/IEC 31010 guidelines and risk assessment techniques.
Define the scope and objectives of the risk assessment process within the organization.
Develop a structured approach for conducting risk identification, analysis, and evaluation.
Assign roles and responsibilities to team members for each phase of the risk assessment process.
Document the findings and ensure they are communicated to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making.

controls.name: risk identification
controls.description: The organization should identify sources of risk, areas of impacts, events (including changes in circumstances) and their causes and their potential consequences. The aim of this step is to generate a comprehensive list of risks based on those events that might create, enhance, prevent, degrade, accelerate or delay the achievement of objectives.

deployment_points.name: Conduct workshops or brainstorming sessions with stakeholders to identify potential sources of risk.
Create a comprehensive risk register that lists identified risks along with their sources and potential impacts.
Utilize tools such as SWOT analysis or PESTLE analysis to enhance risk identification.
Regularly review and update the risk register to capture new risks as they arise.
Ensure that all identified risks are categorized based on their potential impact and likelihood.

controls.name: risk analysis
controls.description: Risk analysis involves developing an understanding of the risk. Risk analysis provides an input to risk evaluation and to decisions on whether risks need to be treated, and on the most appropriate risk treatment strategies and methods.

deployment_points.name: Analyze the identified risks to determine their likelihood and potential impact on organizational objectives.
Use qualitative and quantitative methods to assess the severity of each risk.
Document the analysis process and findings in a risk analysis report.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the analysis to ensure diverse perspectives are considered.
Prepare the analyzed risks for presentation in the subsequent risk evaluation phase.

controls.name: risk evaluation
controls.description: The purpose of risk evaluation is to assist in making decisions, based on the outcomes of risk analysis, about which risks need treatment and the priority for treatment implementation. Risk evaluation involves comparing the level of risk found during the analysis process with risk criteria established when the context was considered.

deployment_points.name: Compare the analyzed risks against the established risk criteria to determine their significance.
Prioritize risks based on their evaluation results to identify which require immediate treatment.
Document the evaluation process and decisions made regarding risk treatment priorities.
Communicate the evaluation outcomes to relevant stakeholders for transparency and accountability.
Review and adjust the risk evaluation criteria periodically to ensure they remain aligned with organizational objectives.

controls.name: general
controls.description: Risk treatment involves selecting one or more options for modifying risks, and implementing those options. Once implemented, treatments provide or modify the controls.

deployment_points.name: Identify and evaluate potential risk treatment options based on the results of the risk evaluation.
Select the most appropriate treatment options that align with organizational objectives and resources.
Develop an implementation plan that outlines the steps, resources, and timelines for each treatment option.
Assign responsibilities to team members for executing the risk treatment plan.
Monitor the effectiveness of implemented treatments and make adjustments as necessary.

controls.name: selection of risk treatment options
controls.description: Selecting the most appropriate risk treatment option involves balancing the costs and efforts of implementation against the benefits derived, with regard to legal, regulatory, and other requirements such as social responsibility and the protection of the natural environment.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a cost-benefit analysis for each potential risk treatment option.
Consider legal, regulatory, and ethical implications when selecting treatment options.
Engage stakeholders in the selection process to ensure diverse perspectives are considered.
Document the rationale for selecting specific treatment options for transparency.
Review selected options periodically to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: preparing and implementing risk treatment plans
controls.description: The purpose of risk treatment plans is to document how the chosen treatment options will be implemented. The information provided in treatment plans should include: the reasons for selection of treatment options, including expected benefits to be gained; those who are accountable for approving the plan and those responsible for implementing the plan; proposed actions; resource requirements including contingencies; performance measures and constraints; reporting and monitoring requirements; and timing and schedule.

deployment_points.name: Draft a risk treatment plan that outlines the selected treatment options and their implementation steps.
Specify roles and responsibilities for plan approval and execution within the treatment plan.
Include resource requirements and contingency plans to address potential challenges.
Establish performance measures to evaluate the effectiveness of the treatment options.
Set a timeline for implementation and schedule regular reviews of the treatment plan.

controls.name: monitoring and review
controls.description: Both monitoring and review should be a planned part of the risk management process and involve regular checking or surveillance. Responsibilities for monitoring and review should be clearly defined.

deployment_points.name: Establish a monitoring schedule that outlines the frequency and scope of reviews to ensure consistent oversight of risk management activities.
Assign specific roles and responsibilities to team members for conducting monitoring and review, ensuring accountability and clarity in the process.
Develop and implement standardized checklists or templates to guide the monitoring and review process, facilitating thorough and consistent evaluations.
Utilize automated tools or software to track and report on risk management activities, enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of monitoring efforts.
Conduct regular training sessions for staff involved in monitoring and review to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively.

controls.name: recording the risk management process
controls.description: Risk management activities should be traceable. In the risk management process, records provide the foundation for improvement in methods and tools, as well as in the overall process.

deployment_points.name: Create a centralized repository for all risk management records, ensuring that all documentation is easily accessible and organized for future reference.
Implement a standardized format for recording risk management activities, including details such as date, participants, decisions made, and actions taken.
Establish a process for regularly reviewing and updating records to reflect any changes in the risk management process or new insights gained from activities.
Train staff on the importance of accurate record-keeping and the specific procedures for documenting risk management activities to ensure compliance and consistency.
Conduct periodic audits of the recorded risk management activities to verify accuracy and completeness, identifying areas for improvement in documentation practices.
